blocks.text: Thank you for the note, and for the time on the call last week. That conversation settled which audience we lead with, and it has already sharpened the first set of core messages for {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}}. Amy Carter has the draft in hand and will work your marks in as they come.

The next piece is the round of short interviews with your executives, so the language sits on how they actually speak rather than on our guess at it. Before I propose times, it would help to know which two or three people you would like us to sit with, and roughly when they tend to be free over the coming fortnight.

Send me the names and I will come back the same day with a few windows that fit their diaries. For the file, sign-off on the Suarez-Jones messaging stays with you, Jennifer Herrera, so nothing firms up without your word.
